verdict.rationale: Railway's first-party marketing says you can connect a repo and 'Railway handles the rest' with auto-config, and says configuration files are optional ('YAML optional'), which directly matches the story. It also gives every pull request its own preview environment. However, the support rests on short marketing statements rather than in-depth docs. Missing for 10: detailed documentation of how builds are auto-detected (supported languages/frameworks, build behavior), and independent or hands-on confirmation that zero-config repo deploys work in practice.
